title: Founder Dependency Score™
tagline: Could your business run without you for a month? Find out — and fix it.
description: 12 questions that measure how much your business depends on you personally — and show you which systems, delegation moves and automations would set you free.

categories.label: Delegation
categories.recommendation: List every task only you can do today. For each, ask: could someone else do this at 80% quality with a checklist? Start handing those off this month.

categories.label: Documentation
categories.recommendation: Record yourself doing your 3 most critical tasks (a simple screen recording works), have AI turn the transcripts into step-by-step guides, and store them in one shared hub.

categories.label: Systems & Automation
categories.recommendation: Replace yourself with systems where possible: automated scheduling, follow-up, invoicing and reporting remove entire categories of founder work.

categories.label: Decision Making
categories.recommendation: Write simple decision rules (spending limits, discount rules, escalation criteria) so your team can decide without you for 90% of situations.

questions.text: How many of your weekly tasks could ONLY be done by you?

options.label: Very few — most work is delegated

questions.text: Do clients insist on dealing with you personally?

options.label: Rarely — they trust the team and the system

questions.text: When you delegate a task, what usually happens?

options.label: I don't delegate — faster to do it myself
It comes back with problems I must fix
It gets done well — clear instructions, clear ownership

questions.text: If you disappeared for a month, could your team find how to do things in writing?

options.label: No — it's all in my head
Yes — a complete, current operations manual

questions.text: Are your prices, packages and standard terms written down where the team can use them?

options.label: No — pricing lives in my head
Yes — documented with rules for exceptions

questions.text: Could someone else access every account and tool if you were unreachable?
How much of your customer journey (booking, onboarding, follow-up, invoicing) runs automatically?

options.label: Most of it runs without me

questions.text: Does new business (leads, referrals, marketing) depend on your personal activity?

options.label: Entirely — if I stop, leads stop
No — marketing runs on systems and automation

questions.text: Have you taken a real vacation (1+ week, minimal contact) in the last year?

options.label: Yes, but I worked through it
Yes — fully offline, business ran fine

questions.text: How many decisions per day come to you that someone else could make?

options.label: Constant — I'm the bottleneck for everything
Rare — the team decides within clear rules

questions.text: Does your team have written rules for common decisions (refunds, discounts, spending, exceptions)?

options.label: No — they ask me every time

questions.text: If a problem hit while you were on a plane for 8 hours, what would happen?

options.label: Everything would wait for me to land
The team would handle most of it
Handled — clear escalation and authority exist

bands.label: Owner-Trapped — You ARE the business
bands.summary: Right now, the business doesn't run without you — which caps your growth, your freedom and your company's sale value at whatever YOU can personally sustain. The escape route is systematic: document, delegate, automate — in that order.
actionPlan: Week 1: Track a week of your time. Mark every task as: only-me, delegatable, or automatable.
Week 1: Set up a shared password manager — remove yourself as the access bottleneck.
Week 2: Record screen videos of your 3 most critical tasks; have AI turn them into written guides.
Week 2: Automate scheduling and invoice chasing — two founder jobs gone.
Week 3: Delegate ONE recurring task fully, with a checklist and a named owner.
Week 3: Write decision rules: spending limits, discount limits, when to escalate.
Week 4: Take one full day off as a test. Note everything that breaks — that's next month's list.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to map which founder tasks AI can absorb first.

bands.label: Partially Free — The bottleneck is shrinking
bands.summary: You've built some independence, but the business still leans on you for too many decisions, too much knowledge and too much daily drive. You're closer than you think: most owners at this stage can reach 'runs without me for 2 weeks' within a quarter.
actionPlan: Week 1: List every decision that reached you last week — write a rule for each repeat offender.
Week 1: Identify your weakest area from the breakdown below and make it the month's focus.
Week 2: Document the 3 processes that still live only in your head.
Week 2: Automate one customer-journey step you still drive manually.
Week 3: Hand a client relationship fully to a team member with a clear playbook.
Week 3: Build a marketing system that generates leads without your daily activity.
Week 4: Test with 3 days fully offline. Fix what wobbles.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to accelerate the remaining handoffs with AI.

bands.label: Owner-Independent — Protect and compound it
bands.summary: Rare air: your business largely runs on systems and team, not your hourly presence. Your job now is protecting that freedom (systems decay!) and using it — for growth, higher-value work or eventually a premium exit.
actionPlan: Week 1: Stress-test: list the 3 things that would still need you in a crisis. Systemize one.
Week 1: Schedule quarterly reviews of your documentation so it stays current.
Week 2: Add AI to your reporting so you steer with a weekly scorecard, not meetings.
Week 2: Cross-train so no single person (including you) is a point of failure.
Week 3: Reinvest your freed time: new offer, new market or strategic partnerships.
Week 3: Have your #2 run the business for a full week while you observe only.
Week 4: Document YOUR remaining role — the last playbook is the founder's.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to explore what full AI leverage makes possible next.

tools.name: Loom

tools.use: Turn recordings and notes into clean written procedures instantly.

tools.name: Notion
tools.use: One hub for every process, playbook and decision rule.

tools.use: Automate the routine steps you still push manually.
